annotations.title: Check a website for orphan pages and broken internal links

description: Use this when someone asks you to check the internal links of one specific public website they run or have permission to check: pages that nothing links to (orphan pages), broken internal links, sitemap entries that redirect or fail, and weakly linked pages. Send one website address per call, for example "example.com". The check reads a small sample of that site (a page limit applies, and the answer says whether every linked page was reached), follows its robots.txt, pauses between requests, and takes up to about half a minute. Returns up to 5 rows with a summary and up to 5 example addresses per kind of finding, the time of the check, and a link to the free web tool. Findings are leads to verify, not a ranking or traffic prediction. Do not use it for sites the person has no reason to check, for backlinks, keywords, page speed or rankings, or to read many sites in a row. It has a small daily limit and refuses private or internal addresses.

website.description: One public website address, for example "example.com". 4-253 characters. Private or internal addresses are refused.
